prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native-alpha modular 2D dungeon sprite atlas.
The attached image is a STYLE AND PROJECTION REFERENCE only, not an edit target. Generate a NEW compact four-corner cap atlas for matching room-to-corridor junctions.
One transparent square PNG, 2x2 equal quadrants, with FOUR SEPARATE complete L-shaped slate-blue stone wall-top modules, one in each quadrant. Generous completely transparent gutters around every module and between quadrants. No background, no checkerboard painted, no floor, no shadows beyond the silhouettes, no labels.
Upper-left: L with arms to RIGHT and DOWN (┌).
Upper-right: L with arms to LEFT and DOWN (┐).
Lower-left: L with arms to RIGHT and UP (└).
Lower-right: L with arms to LEFT and UP (┘).
Each L must be compact: horizontal TOTAL reach about 2.1 times the strip thickness; vertical TOTAL reach about 3.0 times the strip thickness. Uniform strip thickness. Draw three or four complete small stones in each L, joined by thin dark native outlines. Both free ends must be complete flat joining ends; no projections sticking beyond them.
Match the reference's blue-grey low contrast painted stone, small irregular cracks, soft highlights, thin outlines and beveled edges. View directly overhead with a small front-facing thickness ONLY on horizontal arms, always facing DOWN the page. Vertical arms show TOPS ONLY, absolutely no dark side facade or backing. Four orientations must be drawn correctly with front thickness facing down in all four, not obtained by rotating a shaded object.
These are SHORT horizontal L transitions to fit between existing long outer corners and straight vertical corridor walls. Do not add pillars, upright faces, extra masonry courses, decorative feet, tall walls, or floor tiles. Preserve clean native transparent alpha holes inside each L and all surrounding space. Whole complete silhouettes, no chopped stone ends.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is this newly generated four-corner atlas. Keep its four quadrants, whole silhouettes, true transparent alpha background, slate blue painting, thin outlines, overhead projection, dark horizontal down-facing front thickness, and tops-only vertical arms.
ONE specific geometry correction: shorten EVERY horizontal arm dramatically. Currently each L is about 3.3 strip thicknesses wide. Make each L TOTAL horizontal width only TWO strip thicknesses wide, while keeping the vertical strip thickness and total vertical length unchanged. The horizontal arm must have only ONE small square stone extending sideways from the corner's vertical strip, rather than a separate long rectangular stone. Each L top-down silhouette is now like a narrow letter L with a foot two squares wide, stem three squares high. Top-left RIGHT/DOWN, top-right LEFT/DOWN, lower-left RIGHT/UP, lower-right LEFT/UP. Redraw complete intact small stone ends; no missing alpha bits, no cut stones. Keep all components well inside their original quadrant, no cropping. DO NOT change strip width, stone scale, palette, or vertical lengths. No floor, backing row, labels, pillars, upright sides, extra art.

prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Native-alpha 2D modular dungeon side-wall TOP sprite atlas, matching the attached references.
Image 1 is the current side stone, whose material should be repainted quieter. Image 2 is the established side-wall style reference. Generate ONE NEW atlas of THREE separate complete upright stone TOPS in three equal-width columns, with large transparent gutters. Do not copy its floor or corners. All three stones have the SAME WIDTH and different LENGTHS:
left: short top stone, height/width 1.70;
middle: medium top stone, height/width 2.00;
right: long top stone, height/width 2.55.
Each is one whole stone, no additional blocks. Exact overhead TOP ONLY, all four edges complete flat joining ends with small irregular chamfers. Absolutely NO dark upright facade on any side, no frontal thickness, plinth, feet, exterior backing, shadows on background, floor, labels or props.
Match the established sprite set's muted grey slate-blue paint, coarse softly shaded planes, modest broad pale bevel and thin dark outline. One tiny faint irregular hairline crack on each, different on each stone. Avoid dense sharp X fractures, white wire outlines, saturated ice-blue, glass, noisy fine diamond hatching. These must look like pieces of the existing walls at the SAME STONE SCALE. Equal widths, lengths as specified; every whole sprite fits fully inside its column with native transparent margins on all sides. Actual transparent alpha, no opaque backdrop.

Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit the attached three-stone atlas.
Remove ALL cast shadows, all grey/blue halos and all backdrop pixels around the three complete stones. The background and ALL gutters must be perfectly transparent native alpha, not black or charcoal. Keep ONLY each complete painted stone and its own thin immediate edge outline, with clean completely transparent surroundings. No soft shadow, no glow and no vignette anywhere. Do this removal as the generated image itself; do not leave a checkerboard image.
Preserve the three whole stone shapes, their lengths and widths, slate-blue paint, bevels, cracks, top-only view and three-column arrangement. Do not crop them, add front faces or change their stone pixels. Every component remains inside its column with generous fully transparent margins. Return the three separate complete sprites on genuinely transparent background, ready for a game atlas.
